addFailed: The new record could not be added here (the sheet or the cells under the list may be protected)
changeFailed: The record could not be changed (the sheet or these cells may be protected)
deleteFailed: The record could not be deleted (the sheet may be protected, or a table or merged cell is in the way)
deleteMessage: The record shown will be deleted, and the records under it move up. You can undo this.
needsHeader: The form needs a header row to name its fields
noMore: No more records match the criteria in that direction
selectList: Select a cell in a list with a header row to open its form
title: Form: {sheet}
